at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0003.title: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes
at-0003.content: Reject invalid input by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with codes like `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity`, `negative_amount`; do not use ValueError or bare exceptions.

at-0004.title: Reject bools and non-int quantities explicitly
at-0004.content: When validating integer quantities, check `isinstance(quantity, bool)` first because `bool` is a subclass of `int`; then require `isinstance(quantity, int)` and `quantity > 0`.
